decisions.reason: Glazed industrial sectional doors sit in the firm's core industrial door range and draw on shared production and development investment, so management would sooner attribute any weak website visibility to temporary causes than write off the investment.
The insulated glazed variant fits the firm's announced focus on thermal and compliant building solutions, which makes dropping it hard to justify and keeps it in the range.
Its dedicated product page signals visible public commitment and sizable investment, so escalation of commitment favours keeping it rather than exposing the launch as a mistake.
